subject: Acme Financial — Private VPC & SOC 2 discovery follow-up
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Johnson <sarah.johnson@acme-fin.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-05T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Acme Financial — Private VPC & SOC 2 discovery follow-up

Sarah / James —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

Summary of needs:
- Private/VPC deployment in a US region (preference: us-east-1) with network isolation and controlled egress
- Clarification on SOC 2 / HIPAA posture for vendor onboarding
- Completion of your vendor security questionnaire (you mentioned an XLSX)
- Potential on-prem / air-gapped option for specific workloads

What we (Redwood) can provide today:
- Private deployment options: hosted VPC with customer-managed networking, or an on-prem package for air-gapped environments
- KMS/HSM integrations and audit logging for key events
- Typical deployment diagram (attached) and a short SOC 2 summary (attached)

Requested from Acme:
- Completed vendor security questionnaire (attached in your reply works)
- Network details for the target VPC: preferred CIDR range, proxy/firewall constraints, egress controls, and any IP allowlist requirements
- Compliance contact for legal/infosec (name + email) to route the SOC 2 / HIPAA evidence requests

Next steps / proposed timeline:
1) Acme to send back the completed SQ and confirm region + CIDR (by EOD 2026-12-07)
2) Redwood to schedule a technical deep-dive (30-45m) to review deployment diagram and connectivity (available 2026-12-08 / 2026-12-09)
3) Redwood to begin SQ responses and provide operator-level connectivity guide after deep-dive

I attached: redwood_vpc_diagram_v2.pdf and SOC2_summary_2025.pdf for reference.

If that all looks good I can open the HubSpot deal and attach the SQ to the record.

Thanks,
Marcus
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0124

Attachments: redwood_vpc_diagram_v2.pdf, SOC2_summary_2025.pdf

From: Sarah Johnson <sarah.johnson@acme-fin.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: James Liu <james.liu@acme-fin.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-05T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Acme Financial — Private VPC & SOC 2 discovery follow-up

Thanks Marcus — appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- SOC 2 / HIPAA: We currently maintain SOC 2 Type I (initial report issued 2025) and are in scope for a Type II audit scheduled for Q1 2027. Our legal team confirms we are evaluating HIPAA requirements for a subset of data — will flag during the questionnaire.
- Region: Confirming preference for us-east-1 (data residency requirement for this workload).
- Questionnaire: Attaching our vendor security questionnaire (Acme_Security_SQ_2026.xlsx). James Liu (cc'd) will be the technical point for the questionnaire.

We'd like to kick off the SQ and get the technical deep-dive scheduled. Can you share a concise list of the network artifacts you need (CIDR, outbound ports, proxy details, TLS termination behavior)? Also, please confirm whether Redwood supports bringing our own KMS key in the hosted VPC flow.

Thanks — I look forward to the deep-dive.

Best,
Sarah Johnson
Head of Information Security — Acme Financial
security@acme-fin.com

Attachments: Acme_Security_SQ_2026.xlsx

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Johnson <sarah.johnson@acme-fin.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-06T08:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Acme Financial — Private VPC & SOC 2 discovery follow-up

Sarah / James —

Great — thanks for the questionnaire and the details. Short answers up front:
- Yes, us-east-1 is supported and we can accommodate a customer-managed VPC with your own CIDR.
- You can bring your own KMS key for envelope encryption in the hosted VPC flow; we also support HSM integrations for Dedicated/Private deployments.
- We support HIPAA workloads; we'll flag any additional BAAs needed as part of procurement (legal will follow).

Network artifact checklist (what helps us complete the SQ):
- Target VPC CIDR (preferred /26 or larger)
- Public/Private subnet breakdown and NAT/egress approach
- Required inbound allowlist (if any) and expected egress destinations (FQDNs/IP ranges)
- Proxy/transparent proxy details and TLS termination point
- Any air-gap/on-prem constraints (i.e., fully disconnected control plane vs limited egress)

I've uploaded the VPC diagram and our SOC 2 summary to the shared drive: https://redwood.app/drive/rdw-acme/vpc-diagram.

Proposed deep-dive slots (30-45m): 2026-12-08 10:00-11:00 EST or 2026-12-09 14:00-15:00 EST. Tell me what works and we'll send a calendar invite with an agenda.

I'll assign Rachel to own the SQ responses and Monica to coordinate the technical deck.

Onward —
Marcus
